content.askWelcome: Ask me anything about the Surescripts network: e-prescribing, Real-Time Prescription Benefit, electronic prior authorization, medication history, EPCS and Clinical Direct Messaging. Or ask about your own network data and I will chart it live.
content.askEmptySub: Ask any analytical question about your network data: transactions, response time, rejects, RTPB checks and patient savings, abandonment, EPCS and prior authorization turnaround. Answers come straight from your live data with an interactive chart you can drill into.

chatbot.welcome: Hi! I'm the Surescripts Assistant. Ask me about e-prescribing, RTPB, prior authorization and network performance, or ask a question about your network data.
chatbot.overview: Surescripts runs the nation's leading health information network, connecting EHRs, pharmacies, PBMs, payers and life sciences for e-prescribing, Real-Time Prescription Benefit, electronic prior authorization, medication history and clinical messaging.
